tour.heading: How it works
tour.undoText: Bring back the last profile you passed on. It's a Premium feature.
tour.superText: Tell them you're really interested. It stands out more than a like.
tour.boostText: Your profile shows up sooner for 30 minutes. It's a Premium feature.
tour.filtersText: Search by specialty and time zone. The other filters are Premium.

s1.title: Say what you build and what you're missing
s1.text: Specialties, starting point, availability and ambition. You don't need anything built: you may not even have an idea yet. Answer one or two short questions so people can see how you think.

s2.title: Every card has more than one page
s2.text: One tap on the card moves to the next block: what they're looking for, when they work, where they're starting from and their answers.

s3.title: Like or pass, no fuss
s3.text: Right if you're interested, left to move on to the next person. Nobody knows who you passed on.

s5.title: When the interest is mutual, it's a match
s5.text: You can only talk to people who liked you back. When you match, a private chat opens between the two of you.

s6.title: Talk and see if you click
s6.text: To break the ice, the app suggests a few questions to start with. Nobody hires anybody here: you're peers and you decide together.

s7.title: Join a project or start your own
s7.text: Beyond one-to-one matches, you can form a group of up to 6 people whose skills complement each other, see who's in and talk in the group chat.

premium.title: For those who mean business
premium.sub: The basics are free: profile, swiping, matches and chat. Premium gives you more reach and more control.
premium.b5: Boost: 30 minutes at the top of the deck every month
premium.b6: Advanced filters: availability, ambition, starting point and time zone
premium.note: Renews automatically. Cancel anytime from the store. You subscribe and manage it inside the app, with your Apple or Google account.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. Creating your profile, swiping, matching, chatting and joining groups are free. Premium is optional and adds unlimited likes, undo, seeing who liked you, Super Likes, Boost and advanced filters.
faq.q2: How old do I need to be?
faq.a2: cofounder is for people aged 16 and over. Read our child safety standards.
faq.q3: Is it a dating app or a job board?
faq.a3: Neither. It's for finding someone to build something with as equals: nobody hires anybody. We don't offer legal advice or funding either.
faq.q4: Do I need an idea already?
faq.a4: No. You may have no idea yet, one you haven't started or have tried something small. You say so on your profile and meet people at a similar point.
faq.a5: It's already on the App Store for iPhone: the button on this page takes you straight there. It's coming to Google Play very soon.
faq.a6: From the store you subscribed in: on iPhone, in your Apple account settings → Subscriptions; on Android, in Google Play → Payments & subscriptions. Deleting the app doesn't cancel the subscription.
faq.q7: How do I delete my account?
faq.a7: In the app, under Settings → Account. If you no longer have the app, follow these steps.
faq.q8: What do you do with my data?
faq.a8: Only what's needed for it to work: your profile, your matches and your messages. Your photo is optional and only goes public after an automatic safety review. We don't sell data. The details are in the privacy policy.

closing.title: The best ideas start with two.
closing.sub: Your other half is looking too. Get cofounder and start swiping.
